newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hwan Yung shares limit-down to 5,260 won.
newsitem.headline: Hwan Yung shares limit-down to 5,260 won.

text.p: Shares of Hwan Yung Steel Industry Co fell 450 won, or 7.9 percent, to their daily limit of 5,260 won in early Wednesday trading due to continued concern over the company's internal financial difficulty, brokers said.
"Investors remained concerned over the company's financial difficulties despite the announcement its bank transactions had been normalised," said Choo Hee-yup of Dongwon Securities.
Hwan Yung said in a statement it paid back 590 million won of debt on Tuesday.
The company faced a final payment deadline by the end of Tuesday after it failed to settle the debt on Monday, officials at Chung Chong Bank said on Tuesday.
